title: Remote viewing the inside of the Rendlesham triangular craft
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Remote viewing the inside of the Rendlesham triangular craft, about 1980 (target event); session in the 1980s at Rendlesham Forest / RAF Woodbridge, England, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and I was the one that drew the u that went inside that triangular craft and actually drew the floor plans and the insides and all that.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former US Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer in the 1980s, meaning someone trained to perceive hidden places with the mind, says he was tasked to look at a triangular craft reported in 1980 in Rendlesham Forest, next to a military air base called RAF Woodbridge in England. According to Buchanan, he was the one who went inside the craft with his mind and drew its floor plans and interior, which if true would mean the unknown object was studied by psychic means.
